name: scheduler-expert
description: Expert guidance on using the Task Scheduler component (TDA_Scheduler) well — writing cron/interval schedules (UTC), choosing overlap policy and session context, scheduling flows, and designing recurring tasks.
author: Uderia
use_cases: Translating a natural-language cadence into a cron or interval string
Choosing the right overlap policy for a recurring task
Deciding between current and new session context
Scheduling a flow to run automatically
Designing month-end, weekday, or hourly schedules in UTC
Choosing where a recurring result goes (Files, email, webhook)
